rag_rationale: Enrolment is ahead of plan, but the mandatory Responsible AI module (an AI-literacy compliance item) slips to 2027 and copilot training dates are unconfirmed.
headline: 2,140 staff enrolled, ahead of target; mandatory Responsible AI module slips to January without governance content.
progress: 2,140 employees enrolled in AI Foundations (year-end target 2,000)

risks.title: Responsible AI module content missing
risks.description: Governance content is a month late, so the module cannot be made mandatory; this also affects the EU AI Act AI-literacy obligation.
risks.mitigation: Asked GOV-03 to commit to a date.
risks.evidence: We can't make the path mandatory for all staff without it, and Legal won't let us write it ourselves.

risks.title: Copilot training booked against moving date
risks.description: About 30 sessions for 350 agents may need rebooking if wave 2 slips, and training far ahead of go-live does not stick.
risks.mitigation: Firm date requested from CRM-01 by 25 Oct.
risks.evidence: If it does, we need to rebook ~30 sessions and trainers

risks.title: Sales training date unconfirmed
risks.description: January sales training for the proposal generator has no confirmed go-live to anchor to.
risks.evidence: we planned sales team training for January but have no confirmed go-live date

risks.title: Practice sandbox unfunded for 2027
risks.description: The €65k/year AI practice sandbox is funded for 2026 only.
risks.evidence: Funded for 2026 only from the transformation budget.

dependencies.what: Firm wave 2 go-live date to schedule agent training
Confirmed rollout date for sales training
